messages.en:
{07 14 00}So, yeah, {01 00 00 05 00}I guess I ought
to give you a reward.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nii et jah, {01 00 00 05 00}ma peaksin
sulle vist tasu andma.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I've got a little something
for you. It's just my way
of saying thanks.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mul on sulle midagi väikest.
See on lihtsalt minu viis
aitäh öelda.
